member.name: T:ERPTraining.API.Controllers.AuthController
member.summary: Authentication and authorization controller for user management operations
member.remarks:
This controller handles all authentication-related operations including user registration, login, logout, and JWT token management. It provides secure endpoints for user account management and role-based access control.
Available Operations:
User Registration - Create new user accounts
User Login - Authenticate existing users
Profile Management - Update user profile information
JWT Token Management - Handle token-based authentication
Security:
All endpoints use JWT Bearer token authentication except for registration and login.

member.name: M:ERPTraining.API.Controllers.AuthController.UpdateProfile(ERPTraining.Core.DTOs.UserDto)
member.summary: Updates the current user's profile information
member.remarks:
Updates the authenticated user's profile with the provided information. Only the authenticated user can update their own profile.
Required Authentication: JWT Bearer token
Required Role: Any authenticated user
Sample request:
PUT /api/auth/me { "firstName": "John", "lastName": "Doe", "email": "john.doe@example.com", "department": "IT" }

member.name: M:ERPTraining.API.Controllers.AuthController.Login(ERPTraining.Core.DTOs.LoginDto)
member.summary: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT token
member.returns: Authentication response with JWT token and user information
member.remarks:
Authenticates a user with email and password, returning a JWT token for subsequent API calls. The token should be included in the Authorization header as "Bearer {token}" for protected endpoints.
Token Validity: Tokens are valid for 24 hours
Rate Limiting: Maximum 5 login attempts per minute per IP
Sample request:
POST /api/auth/login { "email": "user@example.com", "password": "SecurePassword123!" }
Sample response:
{ "success": true, "message": "Login successful", "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...", "user": { "id": "123", "firstName": "John", "lastName": "Doe", "email": "user@example.com", "roles": ["User"] } }
member.response: Login successful - Returns JWT token and user information
Authentication failed - Invalid email or password
Too many login attempts - Rate limit exceeded

member.name: M:ERPTraining.API.Controllers.AuthController.Register(ERPTraining.Core.DTOs.RegisterDto)
member.summary: Registers a new user account
member.returns: Authentication response with JWT token and user information
member.remarks:
Creates a new user account with the provided information. Upon successful registration, the user is automatically logged in and receives a JWT token for immediate API access.
Password Requirements:
Minimum 6 characters
At least one uppercase letter
At least one lowercase letter
At least one digit
Email Validation: Email must be unique and in valid format
Sample request:
POST /api/auth/register { "firstName": "John", "lastName": "Doe", "email": "john.doe@example.com", "password": "SecurePassword123!", "confirmPassword": "SecurePassword123!", "department": "IT" }
member.response: Registration successful - Returns JWT token and user information
Registration failed - Invalid data or email/username already exists
Validation failed - Password requirements not met

member.name: M:ERPTraining.API.Controllers.AuthController.TestRoute
member.summary: Gets the current authenticated user's profile information
member.remarks:
Retrieves the profile information for the currently authenticated user. The user is identified from the JWT token provided in the Authorization header.
Required Authentication: JWT Bearer token
Required Role: Any authenticated user
Sample response:
{ "id": "123", "firstName": "John", "lastName": "Doe", "email": "john.doe@example.com", "department": "IT", "isActive": true, "joinDate": "2024-01-15T00:00:00Z", "roles": ["User"] }

member.name: M:ERPTraining.API.Controllers.AuthController.RefreshToken
member.summary: Generates a new JWT token for the currently authenticated user
member.returns: New authentication token with updated expiration

member.name: T:ERPTraining.API.Controllers.ModulesController
member.summary: Training modules management controller
member.remarks:
This controller manages training modules within the ERP Training system. It provides comprehensive CRUD operations for training modules, module progression tracking, and learning objective management.
Key Features:
Module Creation and Management
Learning Progress Tracking
Module Content Organization
Prerequisites and Dependencies
Learning Objectives Management
Available Modules:
The system includes comprehensive training modules covering all aspects of ERP systems:
Data Models & Security
SAP Basics & ERP Fundamentals
Order to Cash Process
Production Planning & Material Management
Finance & Controlling
Sales & Distribution
Project Management & Resource Planning
Workflow & Business Process Management
Integration & System Management
Mobile Solutions & Cloud Integration
Analytics & Business Intelligence
Training Management & Learning Analytics
Security:
All endpoints require JWT Bearer token authentication. Access levels vary by user role.

member.name: M:ERPTraining.API.Controllers.ModulesController.GetAllModules
member.summary: Retrieves all available training modules for the authenticated user
member.returns: List of training modules with progress information
member.remarks:
Returns a comprehensive list of all training modules available to the authenticated user, including their progress status, completion percentage, and access permissions.
Returned Data Includes:
Module basic information (ID, title, description)
User progress tracking (completion %, last accessed)
Learning objectives and prerequisites
Estimated duration and difficulty level
Section count and structure
Module Categories:
Modules are organized into comprehensive categories covering:
Foundational ERP concepts and data management
Core business processes (O2C, P2P, R2R)
Advanced functionality and integration
Analytics and reporting capabilities
Sample response:
[ { "id": 1, "title": "Data Models & Security", "description": "Learn fundamental data structures and security concepts...", "completionPercentage": 75, "estimatedDuration": "4 hours", "sectionCount": 52, "isCompleted": false, "lastAccessedAt": "2024-07-29T10:30:00Z" } ]

member.name: M:ERPTraining.API.Controllers.ModulesController.GetModuleById(System.Int32)
member.summary: Retrieves detailed information for a specific training module
member.param: The unique identifier of the module
member.returns: Detailed module information including sections and progress
member.remarks:
Returns comprehensive details for a specific training module, including all sections, user progress, learning objectives, and prerequisites. This endpoint provides the complete module structure needed for the learning interface.
Detailed Information Includes:
Complete module metadata and structure
All sections with content organization
User-specific progress and completion status
Learning objectives and outcomes
Prerequisites and recommended preparation
Assessment information and requirements
Progress Tracking:
The response includes detailed progress information:
Overall module completion percentage
Section-by-section progress status
Time spent in module and sections
Last accessed timestamps
Sample response:
{ "id": 1, "title": "Data Models & Security", "description": "Comprehensive training on data structures...", "completionPercentage": 75, "sections": [ { "id": 1, "title": "Introduction to Data Models", "order": 1, "isCompleted": true } ], "learningObjectives": ["Understand data structures", "..."], "prerequisites": ["Basic computer knowledge"] }
